'''Anyar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Anguilla]] who was the tribal leader of a group of Anguilla that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alluuvia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point during the conflict, a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents traveled to Alluuvia and encountered Anyar and the Anguilla. In order for the Rebels to prove to him that their intentions were honorable, Anyar led the agents to a submerged cave and requested that they engage in the [[Rites of Conch-tar]], a sacred Anguilla ceremony. The Rebels completed the ritual and later, Anyar offered to provide hundreds of Anguilla warriors to assist the agents during an attack on a base that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had established on Alluuvia.
